keyInventory.selection: Object keys; all four build receipts have the same key set

derivation: Split each original inventory key once at / into ownership and original case name.
Map the original case name to its source case name using caseNameMapping, leaving every other name unchanged.
Select the complete source trace at ownership/source-case-name.
Copy the trace object, restore its case field to the original case name, and store it under the original inventory key.
Serialize the resulting object as UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=true, ensure_ascii=true, and separators=[comma,colon].
Verify the canonical JSON byte count and SHA256; these identify the reconstructed trace independently of gzip encoding.

verification.encodingScope: The compressed-byte match was verified with the recorded Python/zlib encoding. Other gzip encodings may differ; the canonical JSON hash is the portable verification gate.
